items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: John the bell, done got over. John the bell. You understand? ... Now that's where the Dixieland pick it up from there.

ctx.x: Well, I have lots of questions to ask. Well, okay. But I want to know what you want to tell me about jazz. I've read your life story that you wrote for too late.

Well, that's not what I wanted to actually tell you about. Not myself. Oh, well tell me what you want to tell me about. I want to, you know, the important thing is what you have to say. Well, I'm going to tell you one of the curious things that I, uh, I found when I came back to New Orleans that so many of the old musicians actually forgot the difference between traditional jazz and New Orleans jazz. Oh, you mean they have forgotten it? They have forgotten. And, uh, they all confused and they call it all…
What do they mean by play it hot?
